title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Wente Vineyards, Livermore | 2006
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Wente Vineyards in Livermore, California, USA, on 27 June 2006.

It was the ninth show by the ninth All-Starr Band. Their tour of North America lasted for 25 dates in June and July 2006.

The ninth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Billy Squier: vocals, guitar
  • Richard Marx: vocals, guitar, keyboards
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Rod Argent: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar
  • Sheila E: vocals, drums, percussion

Concert setlist

  • It Don’t Come Easy
  • ‘What Goes On’
  • ‘Everybody Wants You’ (Billy Squier)
  • ‘Free Ride’ (Edgar Winter)
  • ‘A Love Bizarre’ (Sheila E)
  • ‘Boys’
  • ‘Don’t Mean Nothing’ (Richard Marx)
  • ‘She’s Not There’ (Rod Argent)
  • ‘Never Without You’
  • ‘Yellow Submarine’
  • ‘Frankenstein’ (Edgar Winter)
  • ‘Photograph’
  • ‘Choose Love’
  • ‘Should’ve Known Better’ (Richard Marx)
  • ‘The Glamorous Life’ (Sheila E)
  • ‘I Wanna Be Your Man’
  • ‘Rock Me Tonite’ (Billy Squier)
  • ‘Hold Your Head Up’ (Rod Argent)
  • ‘Act Naturally’
  • ‘Memphis In Your Mind’
  • ‘With A Little Help From My Friends’
